placements.why: Both directives command erasure of specific, named knowledge artifacts — a fleet, its contracts, zeppelin routes — asserting rank-based control over what the recipient may retain. This names an organizational practice (governing what knowledge persists or is removed) that no existing strata category covers, and the repo has no strata yet.
placements.title: Authority over what knowledge persists
placements.frame: What practices govern the retention, removal, and scope of organizational knowledge?

placements.title: Commanded forgetting of named knowledge
placements.frame: What knowledge is targeted for erasure, and how is the scope of removal delimited by the directive?
placements.why: Both segments perform flat matter-of-fact imperatives using stock-phrase formulas ('Forget everything about' / 'Remove all knowledge of') to direct total erasure of concrete, named knowledge artifacts. 'Everything' and 'all' operate as totalizing scope-setters over enumerated targets. This names a thematic subject — directed knowledge removal as a commanded practice — that future envelopes could feed, not a one-time fact or measurement. No existing leaf holds this theme.
